SPIKE 010 NEGATIVE CONTROL -- ONE Set Brightness with NO value.
Not a probe of the coercion. A probe of the CHANNEL: does an unfilled parameter report differently from a device that cannot change its brightness? The coerced leg reported 'There was a problem setting the brightness'. If this one reports 'Please choose a value for each parameter in this action' instead, the two stages are observably distinct and the coerced leg cleared parameter validation. If it reports the same message, the channel cannot tell them apart and no run-time conclusion may be drawn from either.
